messages.action_latest: Speak the latest earthquake from BMKG
messages.action_recent: Open the list of recent earthquakes
messages.stale_notice: Showing the last earthquake data from {time}.
messages.no_data: No earthquake data yet. Press Refresh to try again.
messages.err_offline: Could not reach the earthquake data service. Check your internet connection.
messages.err_service: The earthquake data service is not responding properly. Please try again later.
messages.err_bad_response: The earthquake data service sent data Hariku could not read. Please try again later.
messages.disclaimer: Hariku is not an official warning system. Always follow BMKG and your local authorities.
messages.attribution: Earthquake data: BMKG (Badan Meteorologi, Klimatologi, dan Geofisika) and USGS
messages.head_nearby: Earthquake near you, according to BMKG
messages.head_felt: Earthquake felt in your region, according to BMKG
messages.usgs_tsunami_flag: USGS has set its tsunami flag, which it does for large earthquakes at sea. The flag alone does not mean a tsunami was generated.
messages.briefing_quake: Earthquake near you in the last 24 hours, according to BMKG: {text}.
messages.briefing_tsunami: BMKG reported tsunami potential for it.
messages.chk_list_world: Include strong earthquakes worldwide from USGS (magnitude 5 and above, last 24 hours)
messages.lbl_current_location: Its own place, for distances and nearby alerts:
messages.lbl_search: City to search for, for its own place (press Enter to search):
messages.lbl_results_count: City search results, {count} found. Select your city, then press OK:
messages.search_too_short: Type at least 2 letters of the city name.
messages.search_found_one: 1 place found. Select it in the search results, then press OK.
messages.search_found: {count} places found. Select your city in the search results, then press OK.
messages.err_search: Could not search for cities. Check your internet connection and try again.
messages.chk_tsunami: Announce earthquakes BMKG says have tsunami potential, wherever they are (recommended)
messages.lbl_min_magnitude: Minimum magnitude for earthquakes near me:
messages.chk_felt: Announce earthquakes BMKG reports as felt in my region
messages.lbl_felt_names: Other region names to look for in felt reports, such as your regency (comma separated, optional):
messages.felt_note: Felt alerts look for these names in BMKG's felt reports: {names}.
messages.felt_note_none: Felt alerts need a city or a region name to look for.
messages.chk_world: Announce strong earthquakes anywhere in the world (USGS, magnitude 6.5 and above)
messages.alerts_note: While Hariku is running, alerts check BMKG about every minute and USGS about every 5 minutes. Each earthquake is announced once. Earthquakes more than an hour old are not announced (three hours for tsunami potential).
